Notes from behind the counter

Since you’re here.

May I squeak the chickens?

You may. Once. Gus has a very generous definition of “once,” but you should not test it.

Does Gus actually like his customers?

He knows every dog by name and keeps the door open a little longer than he admits. Draw your own conclusions.

What’s his philosophy?

Useful things. Clear explanations. Dogs deserve better; humans require supervision.

That tail isn’t going to wag itself.

Something for your good dog.
